title: Equivalence of two Fourier granularity conditions
statement: For every natural number $n$, real-valued function $f$ on the vector space $\mathbb F_2^n$, and real number $\varepsilon$, the following are equivalent: every dual Fourier coefficient of $f$ is an integer multiple of $\varepsilon$, and every Fourier coefficient of the corresponding function on the sign cube is an integer multiple of $\varepsilon$.
